```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# NEW MODEL INPUT
# ============================================================

MODEL_data_new <- read_tsv(
  "ALL_Combined_10082026.tsv",
  col_names = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# FEATURES USED FOR MODELING
# ============================================================

model_features <- c(
  "XR_12m",
  "XR_1h",
  "XR_4h",
  "XR_8h",
  "XR_16h",
  "XR_24h",
  "XR_48h",

  "DNase",
  "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me1",
  "H3K4me3",
  "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF",

  "RNA_RPKM",

  "3D_Distance"
)


# ============================================================
# FINAL MODEL DATA
# ============================================================

MODEL_data <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    all_of(model_features),
    Group
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "C_H_M_H",
        "C_H_M_L",
        "C_L_M_H",
        "C_L_M_L"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# CHECK
# ============================================================

dim(MODEL_data)

names(MODEL_data)

table(MODEL_data$Group)

head(MODEL_data)
```


```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(33)


# ======================================================
# 1. Prepare modeling data
# ======================================================

stopifnot(
  "Group" %in% names(MODEL_data)
)


MODEL_data$Group <- factor(
  MODEL_data$Group,
  levels = c(
    "C_H_M_H",
    "C_H_M_L",
    "C_L_M_H",
    "C_L_M_L"
  )
)


# ======================================================
# 2. Keep numeric model features only
# ======================================================

DF_CLEAN <- MODEL_data %>%
  select(
    where(is.numeric),
    Group
  )


# Remove rows with missing model values
DF_CLEAN <- DF_CLEAN %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(.)
  )


cat("\nFeatures used for modeling:\n")

print(
  setdiff(
    names(DF_CLEAN),
    "Group"
  )
)


# ======================================================
# 3. Build High-CPD dataset
#
# C_H_M_H = CPD High / Mutation High
# C_H_M_L = CPD High / Mutation Low
# ======================================================

high_cpd_df <- DF_CLEAN %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c(
      "C_H_M_H",
      "C_H_M_L"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "C_H_M_H",
        "C_H_M_L"
      )
    )
  )


# ======================================================
# 4. Build Low-CPD dataset
#
# C_L_M_H = CPD Low / Mutation High
# C_L_M_L = CPD Low / Mutation Low
# ======================================================

low_cpd_df <- DF_CLEAN %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c(
      "C_L_M_H",
      "C_L_M_L"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "C_L_M_H",
        "C_L_M_L"
      )
    )
  )


# ======================================================
# CHECK
# ======================================================

cat("\nHigh-CPD counts:\n")
print(
  table(
    high_cpd_df$Group
  )
)


cat("\nLow-CPD counts:\n")
print(
  table(
    low_cpd_df$Group
  )
)
```

#XGBOOST training
```{r}
# ======================================================
# XGBOOST FUNCTION
# Fixed seed + fixed folds
# ======================================================

fit_xgb_subset <- function(
  df,
  nrounds = 300,
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 6,
  seed = 33
) {

  stopifnot(
    "Group" %in% names(df)
  )


  set.seed(seed)


  # ====================================================
  # Positive class = first factor level
  #
  # High CPD:
  # 1 = C_H_M_H
  # 0 = C_H_M_L
  #
  # Low CPD:
  # 1 = C_L_M_H
  # 0 = C_L_M_L
  # ====================================================

  y <- as.integer(
    df$Group ==
      levels(df$Group)[1]
  )


  X <- df %>%
    select(
      -Group
    )


  # ====================================================
  # Remove constant predictors
  # ====================================================

  keep <- sapply(
    X,
    function(z) {

      length(
        unique(
          z[
            !is.na(z)
          ]
        )
      ) > 1

    }
  )


  X <- X[
    ,
    keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (
    ncol(X) == 0
  ) {

    stop(
      "No usable predictors remain after removing constant columns."
    )
  }


  # ====================================================
  # XGBoost matrix
  # ====================================================

  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
    data = as.matrix(X),
    label = y
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Parameters
  # ====================================================

  params <- list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "auc",
    eta = eta,
    max_depth = max_depth,
    subsample = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    nthread = 1
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Fixed 5-fold split
  # ====================================================

  set.seed(seed)


  folds <- caret::createFolds(
    factor(y),
    k = 5,
    list = TRUE,
    returnTrain = FALSE
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Cross-validation
  # ====================================================

  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    folds = folds,
    nrounds = nrounds,
    verbose = 0,
    early_stopping_rounds = 20,
    maximize = TRUE
  )


  best_round <- cv$best_iteration


  if (
    is.null(best_round) ||
    length(best_round) == 0 ||
    is.na(best_round)
  ) {

    best_round <- nrounds

    message(
      "best_iteration not returned; using nrounds = ",
      best_round
    )
  }


  # ====================================================
  # Train final model
  # ====================================================

  xgb_fit <- xgb.train(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_round,
    verbose = 0
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Prediction
  # ====================================================

  preds <- predict(
    xgb_fit,
    as.matrix(X)
  )


  pred_label <- ifelse(
    preds > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Confusion matrix
  # ====================================================

  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
    factor(
      pred_label,
      levels = c(
        0,
        1
      )
    ),
    factor(
      y,
      levels = c(
        0,
        1
      )
    ),
    positive = "1"
  )


  # ====================================================
  # AUC
  # ====================================================

  auc_val <- as.numeric(
    pROC::auc(
      response = y,
      predictor = preds
    )
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Return
  # ====================================================

  list(
    model = xgb_fit,
    preds = preds,
    truth = y,
    cm = cm,
    auc = auc_val,
    best_round = best_round,
    importance = xgb.importance(
      model = xgb_fit
    ),
    kept_features = colnames(X),
    folds = folds,
    cv = cv
  )
}


# ======================================================
# TRAIN HIGH-CPD MODEL
# ======================================================

cat(
  "Training High-CPD model...\n"
)

fit_high_xgb <- fit_xgb_subset(
  high_cpd_df,
  seed = 33
)


# ======================================================
# TRAIN LOW-CPD MODEL
# ======================================================

cat(
  "Training Low-CPD model...\n"
)

fit_low_xgb <- fit_xgb_subset(
  low_cpd_df,
  seed = 33
)
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# EVALUATION SUMMARY WITH AUPRC
# ======================================================

library(PRROC)

evaluate_xgb_metrics <- function(
  fit_obj,
  model_name = "Model"
) {

  truth <- fit_obj$truth
  preds <- fit_obj$preds


  # ====================================================
  # Predicted class
  # ====================================================

  pred_label <- ifelse(
    preds > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Confusion matrix
  # ====================================================

  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
    factor(
      pred_label,
      levels = c(
        0,
        1
      )
    ),
    factor(
      truth,
      levels = c(
        0,
        1
      )
    ),
    positive = "1"
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Accuracy
  # ====================================================

  accuracy <- as.numeric(
    cm$overall[
      "Accuracy"
    ]
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Precision
  # ====================================================

  precision <- as.numeric(
    cm$byClass[
      "Pos Pred Value"
    ]
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Recall
  # ====================================================

  recall <- as.numeric(
    cm$byClass[
      "Sensitivity"
    ]
  )


  # ====================================================
  # F1
  # ====================================================

  f1 <- ifelse(
    (
      precision +
        recall
    ) > 0,

    2 *
      precision *
      recall /
      (
        precision +
          recall
      ),

    NA_real_
  )


  # ====================================================
  # AUROC
  # ====================================================

  auc_val <- as.numeric(
    pROC::auc(
      response = truth,
      predictor = preds
    )
  )


  # ====================================================
  # AUPRC
  #
  # Positive class = truth == 1
  # Negative class = truth == 0
  # ====================================================

  pr_obj <- PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = preds[
      truth == 1
    ],
    scores.class1 = preds[
      truth == 0
    ],
    curve = FALSE
  )


  auprc_val <- as.numeric(
    pr_obj$auc.integral
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Output
  # ====================================================

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Accuracy = accuracy,
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    F1 = f1,
    AUROC = auc_val,
    AUPRC = auprc_val,
    Best_Rounds = fit_obj$best_round
  )
}


# ======================================================
# HIGH-CPD
# ======================================================

metrics_high <- evaluate_xgb_metrics(
  fit_high_xgb,
  "High-CPD"
)


# ======================================================
# LOW-CPD
# ======================================================

metrics_low <- evaluate_xgb_metrics(
  fit_low_xgb,
  "Low-CPD"
)


# ======================================================
# COMBINE
# ======================================================

metrics_all <- bind_rows(
  metrics_high,
  metrics_low
)


cat(
  "\n[Evaluation Summary]\n"
)

print(
  metrics_all
)


# ======================================================
# SAVE
# ======================================================

write_tsv(
  metrics_all,
  "XGBoost_Evaluation_Summary.tsv"
)
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# ROC CURVES + AUROC
# ======================================================

library(pROC)

# ======================================================
# 1. Build ROC objects
# ======================================================

roc_high <- roc(
  response = fit_high_xgb$truth,
  predictor = fit_high_xgb$preds,
  quiet = TRUE
)

roc_low <- roc(
  response = fit_low_xgb$truth,
  predictor = fit_low_xgb$preds,
  quiet = TRUE
)


# ======================================================
# 2. AUROC values
# ======================================================

auroc_high <- as.numeric(
  auc(roc_high)
)

auroc_low <- as.numeric(
  auc(roc_low)
)


cat(
  sprintf(
    "High-CPD AUROC = %.4f\n",
    auroc_high
  )
)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Low-CPD AUROC = %.4f\n",
    auroc_low
  )
)


# ======================================================
# 3. Plot ROC curves
# ======================================================

plot(
  roc_high,
  col = "#ffd60a",
  lwd = 2,
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  main = "ROC Curves"
)


plot(
  roc_low,
  col = "#7678ed",
  lwd = 2,
  add = TRUE,
  legacy.axes = TRUE
)


abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 1,
  lty = 2,
  col = "gray40"
)


legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(
    sprintf(
      "High-CPD (AUROC = %.3f)",

    ),
    sprintf(
      "Low-CPD (AUROC = %.3f)",
      auroc_low
    )
  ),
  col = c(
    "#ffd60a",
    "#7678ed"
  ),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)

# ======================================================
# PRECISION-RECALL CURVES + AUPRC
# ======================================================

library(PRROC)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# ======================================================
# 1. HIGH-CPD PR curve
#
# Positive class = 1 = C_H_M_H
# Negative class = 0 = C_H_M_L
# ======================================================

pr_high <- pr.curve(
  scores.class0 = fit_high_xgb$preds[
    fit_high_xgb$truth == 1
  ],
  scores.class1 = fit_high_xgb$preds[
    fit_high_xgb$truth == 0
  ],
  curve = TRUE
)


auprc_high <- pr_high$auc.integral


# ======================================================
# 2. LOW-CPD PR curve
#
# Positive class = 1 = C_L_M_H
# Negative class = 0 = C_L_M_L
# ======================================================

pr_low <- pr.curve(
  scores.class0 = fit_low_xgb$preds[
    fit_low_xgb$truth == 1
  ],
  scores.class1 = fit_low_xgb$preds[
    fit_low_xgb$truth == 0
  ],
  curve = TRUE
)


auprc_low <- pr_low$auc.integral


# ======================================================
# 3. Print AUPRC
# ======================================================

cat(
  sprintf(
    "High-CPD AUPRC = %.4f\n",
    auprc_high
  )
)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Low-CPD AUPRC = %.4f\n",
    auprc_low
  )
)

# ======================================================
# 4. Build PR curve dataframe
# ======================================================

pr_high_df <- data.frame(
  Recall = pr_high$curve[, 1],
  Precision = pr_high$curve[, 2],
  Model = "High-CPD"
)


pr_low_df <- data.frame(
  Recall = pr_low$curve[, 1],
  Precision = pr_low$curve[, 2],
  Model = "Low-CPD"
)


pr_df <- bind_rows(
  pr_high_df,
  pr_low_df
)

# ======================================================
# 5. Plot Precision-Recall curves
# ======================================================

p_pr <- ggplot(
  pr_df,
  aes(
    x = Recall,
    y = Precision,
    color = Model
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "High-CPD" = "#ffd60a",
      "Low-CPD" = "#7678ed"
    ),

    labels = c(
      sprintf(
        "High-CPD (AUPRC = %.3f)",
        auprc_high
      ),

      sprintf(
        "Low-CPD (AUPRC = %.3f)",
        auprc_low
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    ),
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      1,
      0.1
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    ),
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      1,
      0.1
    )
  ) +

  coord_equal() +

  labs(
    title = "Precision-Recall Curves",
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


print(
  p_pr
)

# ======================================================
# ROC CURVE DATAFRAME
# ======================================================

roc_high_df <- data.frame(

  TPR = roc_high$sensitivities,

  TPR = roc_low$sensitivities,

roc_df <- bind_rows(
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# ======================================================

plot_xgb_importance <- function(
  imp_df,
  title,
  top_n = 25,
  fill_col = "#4361ee"
) {

  top_df <- imp_df %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = Gain,
      n = top_n
    )


  ggplot(
    top_df,
    aes(
      x = reorder(
        Feature,
        Gain
      ),
      y = Gain
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      fill = fill_col
    ) +

    coord_flip() +

    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Gain (importance)"
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
}


# ======================================================
# HIGH CPD
# ======================================================

imp_high_plot <- plot_xgb_importance(
  fit_high_xgb$importance,
  "XGBoost Feature Importance - High-CPD",

)

# LOW CPD
# ======================================================

imp_low_plot <- plot_xgb_importance(
  fit_low_xgb$importance,
  "XGBoost Feature Importance - Low-CPD",
  fill_col = "#7678ed"
)


print(
  imp_high_plot
)

print(
  imp_low_plot

# ======================================================
# SAVE TABLES
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# SHAP PREPARATION
# ======================================================

library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)
library(scales)
library(grid)


xgb_shap_long <- function(
  fit_obj,
  df,
  target = "Group",
  top_n = 25
) {

  X_all <- df %>%
    select(
      -all_of(target)
    )


  grp <- df[[target]]


  # ====================================================
  # Use exactly the features used to train the model
  # ====================================================

  X <- X_all[
    ,
    fit_obj$kept_features,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  mat <- as.matrix(X)


  # ====================================================
  # SHAP
  # ====================================================

  shap_mat <- predict(
    fit_obj$model,
    mat,
    predcontrib = TRUE
  )


  shap_df <- as.data.frame(
    shap_mat
  )


  if (
    "BIAS" %in% names(shap_df)
  ) {

    shap_df$BIAS <- NULL
  }


  # ====================================================
  # Rank by mean absolute SHAP
  # ====================================================

  mean_abs <- colMeans(
    abs(shap_df),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  valid_feats <- intersect(
    names(mean_abs),
    colnames(X)
  )


  keep_feats <- head(
    valid_feats[
      order(
        mean_abs[
          valid_feats
        ],
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
    ],
    top_n
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Sample IDs
  # ====================================================

  sample_ids <- paste0(
    "S",
    seq_len(
      nrow(X)
    )
  )


  # ====================================================
  # Raw feature table
  # ====================================================

  raw_df <- as.data.frame(X)

  raw_df$Sample <- sample_ids


  # ====================================================
  # Feature Z-scores
  # ====================================================

  Z <- as.data.frame(
    scale(X)
  )

  Z$Sample <- sample_ids


  # ====================================================
  # SHAP long
  # ====================================================

  shap_df$Sample <- sample_ids


  long_shap <- shap_df %>%

    select(
      all_of(keep_feats),
      Sample
    ) %>%

    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Sample,
      names_to = "Feature",
      values_to = "SHAP"
    ) %>%

    left_join(

      Z %>%
        pivot_longer(
          cols = -Sample,
          names_to = "Feature",
          values_to = "Zscore"
        ),

      by = c(
        "Sample",
        "Feature"
      )
    ) %>%

    left_join(
      tibble(
        Sample = sample_ids,
        Group = as.character(grp)
      ),
      by = "Sample"
    )


  list(
    long = long_shap,
    order = keep_feats
  )
}

# ======================================================
# SHAP VIOLIN / SCATTER
# ======================================================

plot_shap_violin_raw <- function(
  long_df,
  class_label,
  feat_order,
  title,
  point_alpha = 0.6,
  point_size = 1.6,
  xlim_override = NULL,
  xbreaks_override = NULL
) {

  dfc <- long_df %>%
    filter(
      Group == class_label
    )


  present_features <- feat_order[
    feat_order %in%
      unique(dfc$Feature)
  ]


  dfc$Feature <- factor(
    dfc$Feature,
    levels = rev(
      present_features
    )
  )


  if (
    is.null(
      xlim_override
    )
  ) {

    q <- quantile(
      abs(
        dfc$SHAP
      ),
      0.98,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )


    lim <- max(
      q,
      1e-6
    )


    xlim_use <- c(
      -lim,
      lim
    )

  } else {

    xlim_use <- xlim_override
  }


  ggplot(
    dfc,
    aes(
      x = SHAP,
      y = Feature,
      color = Zscore
    )
  ) +

    geom_violin(
      scale = "width",
      width = 0.18,
      alpha = 0
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      size = point_size,
      alpha = point_alpha
    ) +

    scale_color_gradientn(
      colors = c(
        "#480ca8",
        "#fff9c5",
        "#ffbe0b"
      ),
      values = scales::rescale(
        c(
          -0.5,
          0,
          0.5
        )
      ),
      limits = c(
        -0.5,
        0.5
      ),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = xlim_use,
      breaks = xbreaks_override
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "SHAP value",
      y = "",
      color = "Z-score"
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.8
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    )
}


# ======================================================
# FEATURE Z-SCORE HEATMAP
# ======================================================

plot_feature_raw_heatmap <- function(
  long_df,
  feat_order,
  title,
  desired_x_order = NULL,
  color_min = -0.5,
  color_max = 0.5
) {

  mean_by_class <- long_df %>%

    group_by(
      Group,
      Feature
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      m = mean(
        Zscore,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%

    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Group,
      values_from = m
    )


  mat <- mean_by_class %>%

    filter(
      Feature %in%
        feat_order
    ) %>%

    column_to_rownames(
      "Feature"
    ) %>%

    as.matrix()


  mat <- mat[
    feat_order[
      feat_order %in%
        rownames(mat)
    ],
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (
    !is.null(
      desired_x_order
    )
  ) {

    cols <- intersect(
      desired_x_order,
      colnames(mat)
    )


    mat <- mat[
      ,
      cols,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  pal <- colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "#480ca8",
      "#fff9c5",
      "#ffbe0b"
    )
  )(200)


  brks <- seq(
    color_min,
    color_max,
    length.out = 201
  )


  pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = title,
    color = pal,
    breaks = brks,
    fontsize = 9,
    fontsize_row = 9,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    angle_col = 45,
    legend = TRUE
  )
}

# ==========================================================
# GLOBAL SHAP IMPORTANCE
# Mean |SHAP| normalized to 100%
# ==========================================================

compute_shap_global_importance <- function(
  fit_obj,
  df,
  target = "Group"
) {

  X_all <- df %>%
    select(
      -all_of(target)
    )


  X <- X_all[
    ,
    fit_obj$kept_features,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  mat <- as.matrix(X)


  shap_mat <- predict(
    fit_obj$model,
    mat,
    predcontrib = TRUE
  )


  shap_df <- as.data.frame(
    shap_mat
  )


  if (
    "BIAS" %in%
      colnames(shap_df)
  ) {

    shap_df$BIAS <- NULL
  }


  imp <- tibble(
    Feature = colnames(
      shap_df
    ),

    MeanAbsSHAP = colMeans(
      abs(
        shap_df
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

    arrange(
      desc(
        MeanAbsSHAP
      )
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      RelativePercent =
        100 *
        MeanAbsSHAP /
        sum(
          MeanAbsSHAP
        )
    )


  return(
    imp
  )
}

# HIGH CPD
# ==========================================================

  fit_high_xgb,
  high_cpd_df
)


# ==========================================================
# LOW CPD

  fit_low_xgb,
  low_cpd_df
)

all_feats_low <- fit_low_xgb$kept_features

# HIGH CPD

  tibble(
    Feature = all_feats_high
  ),
  shap_imp_high,
  by = "Feature"
) %>%

  mutate(
    MeanAbsSHAP = ifelse(
      is.na(MeanAbsSHAP),
      0,
      MeanAbsSHAP
    ),

    RelativePercent = ifelse(
      is.na(RelativePercent),
      0,
      RelativePercent
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      RelativePercent
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# LOW CPD
# ==========================================================

shap_imp_low_full <- full_join(

    Feature = all_feats_low

) %>%

      is.na(MeanAbsSHAP),
      0,
      MeanAbsSHAP
    ),

    RelativePercent = ifelse(
      is.na(RelativePercent),
      0,
      RelativePercent
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      RelativePercent
    )
  )


print(
  shap_imp_high_full
)

print(
  shap_imp_low_full
)

# ==========================================================
# GLOBAL SHAP PLOT FUNCTION
# ==========================================================

plot_shap_importance <- function(
  imp_df,
  title,
  fill_col = "#4361ee"
) {

  ggplot(
    imp_df,
    aes(
      x = reorder(
        Feature,
        RelativePercent
      ),
      y = RelativePercent
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      fill = fill_col
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        0,
        25
      ),
      breaks = seq(
        0,
        25,
        5
      ),
      labels = function(x) {
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          x
        )
      },
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0
        )
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Relative importance (%)"
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        5.5,
        12,
        5.5,
        5.5
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
}

# ==========================================================
# GROUP-MEAN LOCAL SHAP CONTRIBUTION
# SIGNED
# ==========================================================

compute_local_shap_signed <- function(
  fit_obj,
  df,
  target = "Group"
) {

  X_all <- df %>%
    select(
      -all_of(target)
    )


  grp <- df[[target]]


  # ========================================================
  # Exact trained features
  # ========================================================

  X <- X_all[
    ,
    fit_obj$kept_features,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  mat <- as.matrix(X)


  # ========================================================
  # SHAP
  # ========================================================

  shap_mat <- predict(
    fit_obj$model,
    mat,
    predcontrib = TRUE
  )


  shap_df <- as.data.frame(
    shap_mat
  )


  if (
    "BIAS" %in%
      colnames(shap_df)
  ) {

    shap_df$BIAS <- NULL
  }


  # ========================================================
  # Sample ID
  # ========================================================

  sample_ids <- paste0(
    "S",
    seq_len(
      nrow(shap_df)
    )
  )


  shap_df$Sample <- sample_ids


  # ========================================================
  # Long format
  # ========================================================

  local_long <- shap_df %>%

    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Sample,
      names_to = "Feature",
      values_to = "LocalImportance"
    ) %>%

    left_join(
      tibble(
        Sample = sample_ids,
        Group = as.character(grp)
      ),
      by = "Sample"
    )


  return(
    local_long
  )
}
```

#ANOVA

```{r}
# =========================================================
# ANOVA / KRUSKAL-WALLIS
# =========================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)


# =========================================================
# MODEL DATA
# =========================================================

MD <- MODEL_data


MD$Group <- factor(
  MD$Group,
  levels = c(
    "C_H_M_H",
    "C_H_M_L",
    "C_L_M_H",
    "C_L_M_L"
  )
)


colnames(MD) <- make.names(
  colnames(MD),
  unique = TRUE
)


feature_cols <- setdiff(
  names(MD),
  "Group"
)


feature_cols <- feature_cols[
  sapply(
    MD[
      feature_cols
    ],
    is.numeric
  )
]


print(
  feature_cols
)

# =========================================================
# ANOVA FUNCTION
# =========================================================

run_anova_one <- function(
  df,
  feat,
  group_col = "Group"
) {

  dsub <- df[
    ,
    c(
      feat,
      group_col
    )
  ]


  ok <- is.finite(
    dsub[[feat]]
  ) &
    !is.na(
      dsub[[group_col]]
    )


  dsub <- dsub[
    ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (
    nrow(dsub) < 2 ||
    length(
      unique(
        dsub[[group_col]]
      )
    ) < 2
  ) {

    return(
      tibble(
        feature = feat,
        F = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_,
        ss_between = NA_real_,
        ss_total = NA_real_,
        eta2 = NA_real_,
        df_between = NA_integer_,
        df_within = NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }


  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "`",
      feat,
      "` ~ ",
      group_col
    )
  )


  out <- tryCatch({

    fit <- aov(
      fml,
      data = dsub
    )


    an <- summary(
      fit
    )[[1]]


    Fval <- an[
      1,
      "F value"
    ]


    pval <- an[
      1,
      "Pr(>F)"
    ]


    ss_between <- an[
      1,
      "Sum Sq"
    ]


    ss_within <- an[
      2,
      "Sum Sq"
    ]


    ss_total <-
      ss_between +
      ss_within


    df_between <- an[
      1,
      "Df"
    ]


    df_within <- an[
      2,
      "Df"
    ]


    eta2 <- ifelse(
      ss_total > 0,
      ss_between /
        ss_total,
      NA_real_
    )


    tibble(
      feature = feat,
      F = as.numeric(Fval),
      p = as.numeric(pval),
      ss_between = as.numeric(
        ss_between
      ),
      ss_total = as.numeric(
        ss_total
      ),
      eta2 = eta2,
      df_between = as.integer(
        df_between
      ),
      df_within = as.integer(
        df_within
      )
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    tibble(
      feature = feat,
      F = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_,
      ss_between = NA_real_,
      ss_total = NA_real_,
      eta2 = NA_real_,
      df_between = NA_integer_,
      df_within = NA_integer_
    )

  })


  out
}


# =========================================================
# KRUSKAL-WALLIS FUNCTION
# =========================================================

run_kw_one <- function(
  df,
  feat,
  group_col = "Group"
) {

  dsub <- df[
    ,
    c(
      feat,
      group_col
    )
  ]


  ok <- is.finite(
    dsub[[feat]]
  ) &
    !is.na(
      dsub[[group_col]]
    )


  dsub <- dsub[
    ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (
    nrow(dsub) < 2 ||
    length(
      unique(
        dsub[[group_col]]
      )
    ) < 2
  ) {

    return(
      tibble(
        feature = feat,
        kw_stat = NA_real_,
        kw_p = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "`",
      feat,
      "` ~ ",
      group_col
    )
  )


  out <- tryCatch({

    kw <- suppressWarnings(
      kruskal.test(
        fml,
        data = dsub
      )
    )


    tibble(
      feature = feat,
      kw_stat = as.numeric(
        kw$statistic
      ),
      kw_p = as.numeric(
        kw$p.value
      )
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    tibble(
      feature = feat,
      kw_stat = NA_real_,
      kw_p = NA_real_
    )

  })


  out
}


# =========================================================
# RUN ALL FEATURES
# =========================================================

anova_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    feature_cols,
    function(f) {

      run_anova_one(
        MD,
        f,
        "Group"
      )

    }
  )
) %>%

  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      p,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )


kw_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    feature_cols,
    function(f) {

      run_kw_one(
        MD,
        f,
        "Group"
      )

    }
  )
)


kw_df <- kw_df %>%

    )
  )


res_ranked <- anova_df %>%

  left_join(

  ) %>%

  arrange(

  )

)

# =========================================================
# SIGNIFICANCE STARS
# =========================================================

sig_stars <- function(
  padj
) {

  out <- rep(
    "",
    length(padj)
  )


  out[
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.05
  ] <- "*"


  out[
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.01
  ] <- "**"


  out[
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.001
  ] <- "***"


  out[
    !is.na(padj) &
      padj < 0.0001
  ] <- "****"


  out
}


# =========================================================
# ANOVA ETA2 BARPLOT
# =========================================================

plot_anova_eta_bars <- function(
  res_ranked,
  top_n = 33,
  fill_col = "#F28C9D"
) {

  df <- res_ranked %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(eta2)
    ) %>%

    slice_max(
      order_by = eta2,
      n = top_n
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      feature = factor(
        feature,
        levels = rev(
          feature
        )
      ),

      stars = sig_stars(
        p_adj_BH
      )
    )


  pad <- max(
    df$eta2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) * 0.02


  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = feature,
      y = eta2
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      fill = fill_col
    ) +

    geom_text(
      aes(
        y = eta2 + pad,
        label = stars
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 5
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0.12
        )
      )
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        5.5,
        30,
        5.5,
        5.5
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "Features by effect size (eta2)",
      y = expression(
        eta^2
      )
    )
}


p_anova <- plot_anova_eta_bars(
  res_ranked,
  top_n = 33,
  fill_col = "#F28C9D"
)

# =========================================================
# WELCH T-TEST + EFFECT SIZE
# =========================================================

run_ttest_one <- function(
  df,
  feat,
  group_col = "Group"
) {

  dsub <- df[
    ,
    c(
      feat,
      group_col
    )
  ]


  ok <- is.finite(
    dsub[[feat]]
  ) &
    !is.na(
      dsub[[group_col]]
    )


  dsub <- dsub[
    ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  groups <- levels(
    droplevels(
      dsub[[group_col]]
    )
  )


  if (
    length(groups) != 2L ||
    nrow(dsub) < 3
  ) {

    return(
      tibble(
        feature = feat,
        group1 = NA_character_,
        group2 = NA_character_,
        n1 = NA_integer_,
        n2 = NA_integer_,
        mean1 = NA_real_,
        mean2 = NA_real_,
        diff = NA_real_,
        t = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_,
        d = NA_real_,
        g = NA_real_,
        eta2 = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  g1 <- groups[1]

  g2 <- groups[2]


  x1 <- dsub[
    dsub[[group_col]] == g1,
    feat
  ][[1]]


  x2 <- dsub[
    dsub[[group_col]] == g2,
    feat
  ][[1]]


  n1 <- length(x1)

  n2 <- length(x2)


  m1 <- mean(x1)

  m2 <- mean(x2)


  s1 <- stats::sd(x1)

  s2 <- stats::sd(x2)


  # =======================================================
  # Welch t-test
  # =======================================================

  tt <- stats::t.test(
    x1,
    x2,
    var.equal = FALSE
  )


  # =======================================================
  # Cohen's d
  # =======================================================

  sp2 <- (
    (
      n1 - 1
    ) *
      s1^2 +
      (
        n2 - 1
      ) *
      s2^2
  ) /
    max(
      1,
      n1 +
        n2 -
        2
    )


  sp <- sqrt(sp2)


  d <- (
    m1 -
      m2
  ) /
    ifelse(
      sp > 0,
      sp,
      NA_real_
    )


  # =======================================================
  # Hedges' g
  # =======================================================

  J <- 1 -
    3 /
    (
      4 *
        (
          n1 +
            n2
        ) -
        9
    )


  g <- J * d


  # =======================================================
  # eta2
  # =======================================================

  tval <- unname(
    tt$statistic
  )


  dfre <- unname(
    tt$parameter
  )


  eta2 <- if (
    is.finite(tval) &&
    is.finite(dfre)
  ) {

    tval^2 /
      (
        tval^2 +
          dfre
      )

  } else {

    NA_real_
  }


  tibble(
    feature = feat,
    group1 = g1,
    group2 = g2,
    n1 = n1,
    n2 = n2,
    mean1 = m1,
    mean2 = m2,
    diff = m1 - m2,
    t = tval,
    df = dfre,
    p = unname(
      tt$p.value
    ),
    d = d,
    g = g,
    eta2 = eta2
  )
}


# =========================================================
# HIGH CPD
# =========================================================

tt_high <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    feature_cols,
    function(f) {

      run_ttest_one(
        MD_high,
        f,
        "Group"
      )

    }
  )
) %>%

  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      p,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    p_adj_BH,
    p
  )


# =========================================================

# =========================================================

tt_low <- do.call(

  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      p,

    )
  ) %>%

  )

# =========================================================
# ETA2 BARPLOT FUNCTION
# =========================================================

plot_eta_bars <- function(
  tt_df,
  title,
  top_n = 33,
  fill_col = "grey70"
) {

  df <- tt_df %>%

    filter(
      is.finite(
        eta2
      )
    ) %>%

    slice_max(
      order_by = eta2,
      n = top_n
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      feature = factor(
        feature,
        levels = rev(
          feature
        )
      ),

      stars = sig_stars(
        p_adj_BH
      )
    )


  pad <- max(
    df$eta2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) * 0.02


  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = feature,
      y = eta2
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      fill = fill_col
    ) +

    geom_text(
      aes(
        y = eta2 + pad,
        label = stars
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 5
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0.12
        )
      )
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        5.5,
        30,
        5.5,
        5.5
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title,
      y = expression(
        eta^2
      )
    )
}
```
